2607.18639.title: Mark, Don't Erase: Token Inoculation for Dual-Use Knowledge in LLMs
2607.18639.paper_summary: Safety interventions on dual-use knowledge typically choose between destroying hazardous content (e.g., unlearning, filtering) and suppressing it at the output layer (e.g., refusal training); both pay a tax in adjacent-domain competence or over-refusal. We argue that the right operation is conditioning, not reduction: we show that hazardous knowledge can be retained in the model and behaviorally gated by a privileged control token. Our method, Token Inoculation, introduces a binding-and-branching approach. First, during continued pre-training, we mark hazardous content by inserting a special token alongside dual-use documents, so the model binds the marker to the underlying semantics of the hazardous domain. Second, during supervised fine-tuning, we teach the model to answer hazardous queries correctly when the special token is present and to refuse them when it is absent, thereby enabling selective refusal without removing dual-use knowledge. On hazardous domain (e.g., WMDP-Bio), Token Inoculation reduces accuracy from 79% to 18% while retaining 93% of the base-model's benign-domain performance (e.g., MMLU), achieving the best safety-utility trade-off against unlearning and refusal-tuning baselines across 1B-14B model scales. We further show that refusal selectivity is controllable through the quality of the conditioning signal and that domain-specific semantic binding during pre-training is critical for the conditional behavior to generalize beyond memorized triggers. Our results suggest that safety alignment is better cast as a conditioning problem than a forgetting one: behavioral control is more precise when sensitive knowledge is retained under controlled access than when it is destroyed.
2607.18639.paper_summary_zh: 安全干預在雙重用途知識上通常選擇摧毀危險內容（例如，遺忘、過濾）或在輸出層進行抑制（例如，拒絕訓練）；這兩者都在相鄰領域的能力或過度拒絕上付出了代價。我們主張正確的操作是條件化，而不是減少：我們展示了危險知識可以保留在模型中，並通過特權控制標記進行行為閘控。我們的方法，標記免疫，引入了一種綁定和分支的方法。首先，在持續的預訓練過程中，我們通過在雙重用途文檔旁插入特殊標記來標記危險內容，這樣模型就能將標記與危險領域的潛在語義綁定。其次，在監督微調過程中，我們教導模型在特殊標記存在時正確回答危險查詢，而在缺少時拒絕這些查詢，從而實現選擇性拒絕而不移除雙重用途知識。在危險領域（例如，WMDP-Bio）上，標記免疫將準確率從79%降低到18%，同時保留93%的基礎模型在良性領域的性能（例如，MMLU），在1B-14B模型規模上實現了最佳的安全-效用權衡，相較於遺忘和拒絕調整的基準。我們進一步展示了拒絕選擇性可以通過條件信號的質量來控制，並且在預訓練期間的領域特定語義綁定對於條件行為的泛化至關重要。我們的結果表明，安全對齊更應被視為一個條件問題，而不是遺忘問題：當敏感知識在受控訪問下保留時，行為控制比摧毀時更為精確。
